algorithm: Original bounded QK, maxima and probability repair, cached probability intervals and strict BF16 context certificate. Four variants compare independent scalar prepared-dot repair with shared16x16-tile repair, and18 versus6 complete certificate rounds. The wider schedule changes work selection only; both perform complete remaining-score replay before the final certificate. Tile marking uses one bit per original selected cell and one publication per nonempty tile. The tile kernel compacts selected dots into active warps, reuses original operands in two128-feature windows and preserves original carried arithmetic and exceptional full-dot restart.
validation: Complete selected score bit checks, probability BF16/alpha identity, denominator containment at every round, all admitted/final outputs, original inputs and buffer redzones. Tile checks cover every selected membership, all set mask bits, unique tile owners and causal geometry; inspected tile-cell count equals original selected-score count. Matching schedules reproduce identical per-round counts, and the scalar18 schedule reproduces the prior source counts for all generated and captured cases. Counts diagnose execution only; numerical and external GB10 comparisons determine correctness.
component_boundary: Every causal approximate score is checked against the original prepared score envelope; every replayed score is compared bit-for-bit, with independent wide CPU samples. All BF16 probabilities, alpha bits, denominator containment at every round, every admitted output, final output and buffer guards are checked. The q7169 capture compares all29364224 GB10 context cells. q8192 repeats the first1023 captured Q/K/V rows; all33554432 outputs match the original arithmetic, with only the original7169-token prefix independently GB10 anchored. It is not a new q8192 real-model inference or token gate.
timing_scope: Separated completed host phase clocks include completion events. Tile replay includes clearing all tile masks and owners, clearing the device count, marking/compacting tiles and queued arithmetic. No tile count is read by the compute path. Test downloads and full diagnostic kernels are outside phase clocks; full guarded process walls are attached. Shared preparation and candidate canonical PV are separately reported. No model load, inference token loop or TTFT is measured.

decision.decision: Keep every adaptive QK variant isolated and preserve retained dispatch. All component and external GB10 comparisons pass, but the best q8192 candidate takes2177.5395ms versus445.1504ms for its original QK/probability control. Tile repair is slower under both schedules. Collection plus probability interval initialization alone exceeds the complete original QK/probability clock in every q8192 variant, so removing replay cannot rescue this implementation. No current performance or release acceptance follows.
decision.next_step: Inspect routed/shared MoE down-projection consumers and the complete residual/RMSNorm boundary for a structural reduction in dense correction demand. Existing pointwise gate/up invariant fractions are already known to be small; do not repeat those unchanged audits. Any new candidate must preserve all active GB10 continuation gates.
